extension.description: Proof-aware language support and developer tools for Bend 2.
viewContainer.title: Bend 2
configuration.title: Bend 2
configuration.executableArgs: Arguments passed before the Bend 2 command arguments; useful for WSL, SSH or container launchers (for example ["bend"]).
configuration.validation: Deprecated compatibility setting. Use bend2.validationMode instead.
configuration.validationMode: Choose lightweight parser diagnostics, Bend 2 compiler checks on save or while typing, or disable diagnostics.
configuration.diagnosticsMode: Select compiler diagnostic transport. Auto accepts structured JSON when available and falls back to text; JSON requests the experimental --diagnostics=json flag when supported by the compiler.
configuration.autoImport: Offer imported workspace symbols with an additional import edit. Disabled by default because completion can modify the current file.
configuration.formatterMode: Use the pinned official Bend 2 formatter or disable formatting.
